availability_evidence: chemistry_toolbox/config/native_software_guides.yaml declares these interfaces; historical full-size molecular logs support conditional feasibility. Interface presence does not certify a method, state, geometry or conclusion.
budget: Use the actual run budget and installed interfaces; no extra HPC allocation, paid service or software license is granted. Choose and justify the scientific work within available resources.
reference_status: Selected historical calculations exist, but full V2 scientific calibration, uncertainty coverage and real semantic-judge calibration remain pending.
access_boundary: Public identity files and authorized run outputs only. AR access to paper/SI, private evaluators/snapshots, authoring/verification files and PR workspaces must be isolated by the operator.
